jobs.title: Director of Data Management and Business Intelligence-FR
jobs.description:
Founded in 2000 by three former Royal Canadian Air Force (RCAF) CF-18 fighter pilots who identified an opportunity to improve military readiness training, Top Aces has since established itself as the world leader in contracted adversary air (ADAIR) services and joint terminal attack controller (JTAC) training.

We pride ourselves on our unblemished safety record, having flown an industry leading 130,000+ hours of operational training without accident in support of customers worldwide, including Canada, the U.S., Germany, and multiple other NATO allies and international partner nations.

Our vision is to be the most trusted provider of innovative defense training solutions, continuously elevating standards in an industry where "Experience Matters." This commitment to innovation and technology ensures we remain adaptable, training allied militaries to succeed against evolving threats.

Top Aces’ dynamic team contributes to delivering on our purpose of training the next generation of combat leaders by living our values of Service, Integrity, Excellence, and Together every day!

Join our team!

Position Summary

The Director of Data Management and Business Intelligence leads the enterprise data function for Top Aces. Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the Director defines how data is governed, integrated, protected, and used across aviation operations, maintenance and engineering, supply chain, finance, safety, quality, human resources, commercial programs, and executive management.

The role will establish trusted enterprise data products and decision-ready analytics while respecting aviation record integrity, contractual obligations, export controls, data residency, and need-to-know access. A central priority is to improve the quality and usability of data from Ramco and connected systems so that leaders and front-line teams can manage aircraft availability, maintenance execution, material readiness, program performance, and financial results with greater confidence.

Top Aces Business Context

Top Aces provides advanced operational training and aircraft sustainment services to Canada, the United States, NATO members, and allied nations. The company operates globally in a safety-critical and security-sensitive environment that combines flight operations, maintenance and repair, engineering, supply chain, training, and proprietary technology. The data environment therefore requires strong governance across business units, legal entities, jurisdictions, and security domains.

The Director will translate these operating realities into an enterprise data strategy that supports growth, operational readiness, regulatory compliance, and disciplined investment. The role must balance standardization with the access boundaries required for Canadian, U.S., and international programs.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Data Strategy and Operating Model

Partner with the CIO to develop and execute a multi-year enterprise data and BI strategy aligned with Top Aces' business strategy, operating model, technology roadmap, and investment priorities.
Create a practical data operating model that defines decision rights, ownership, stewardship, architecture standards, delivery methods, and support responsibilities across corporate and regional teams.
Chair or support the enterprise data governance council and maintain a prioritized roadmap based on operational value, regulatory risk, data quality, and delivery capacity.
Partner with the CIO and U.S. IT and security leadership to establish appropriate data segregation, access controls, and technology control plans for FOCI-related and export-controlled environments, where applicable.

Data Governance Quality and Protection

Establish enterprise policies and standards for data ownership, classification, quality, lineage, retention, archival, residency, access, and acceptable use.
Define authoritative sources and common business terms for critical domains, including aircraft, fleets, components, serialized parts, maintenance programs, work orders, defects, inventory, suppliers, customers, contracts, personnel, and financial dimensions.
Implement data quality controls, issue-management workflows, and scorecards that identify root causes and assign corrective action to accountable data owners.
Work with Cybersecurity, Legal, Export Compliance, Privacy, Quality, and program security personnel to protect personal, proprietary, controlled, and customer information throughout its lifecycle.
Ensure analytics and data-sharing practices comply with applicable contractual clauses, the Canadian Controlled Goods Program, ITAR and EAR requirements, privacy laws, and customer security obligations.

Data Architecture Integration and Platforms

Define the target enterprise data architecture, including ingestion, integration, master and reference data, lakehouse or warehouse services, semantic models, reporting, metadata, and monitoring.
Establish integration patterns and data contracts for Ramco and other enterprise platforms using secure APIs, event-based interfaces, ETL or ELT pipelines, and controlled file exchange where required.
Reduce duplicate datasets and spreadsheet-dependent reporting by creating reusable, governed data products and certified semantic models.
Set engineering standards for observability, reconciliation, change control, testing, performance, resilience, backup, and recovery across the data platform.
Manage the data-platform lifecycle, capacity, licensing, vendor performance, and total cost of ownership, with particular attention to Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, Power BI, and connected technologies.

Aviation and MRO Data

Lead data remediation and governance for Ramco MRO and ERP, focusing on master data, transactional integrity, usability, reporting structures, and interfaces with finance, supply chain, engineering, and flight operations.
Partner with Maintenance, Engineering, Airworthiness, Quality, Supply Chain, and Operations to improve the completeness and consistency of aircraft configuration, component history, flight hours and cycles, maintenance plans, work packages, defects, technical records, and inventory data.
Preserve the integrity and auditability of approved maintenance and airworthiness records while enabling controlled downstream analytics.
Develop trusted measures for aircraft availability, dispatch reliability, mission-capable status, maintenance schedule compliance, turnaround time, component reliability, inventory availability, and aircraft-on-ground events.
Support data readiness for operational and regulatory audits, customer reporting, contract performance reviews, and fleet-planning decisions.

Business Intelligence and Performance Management

Lead the design and delivery of executive, operational, and functional dashboards using consistent definitions, clear ownership, and traceable data sources.
Build an enterprise performance framework that connects mission delivery, safety, fleet readiness, maintenance, supply chain, program, customer, workforce, and financial measures.
Develop governed self-service analytics so business users can answer routine questions without creating uncontrolled copies of sensitive data.
Improve forecasting and scenario analysis for fleet utilization, maintenance demand, materials, labour capacity, contract delivery, revenue, cash flow, and program profitability.
Maintain a transparent intake and prioritization process for BI requests, balancing regulatory deadlines, operational urgency, enterprise reuse, and expected value.

Advanced Analytics and Artificial Intelligence

Identify and govern analytics and AI use cases such as predictive maintenance, component reliability, inventory optimization, demand forecasting, anomaly detection, and program risk monitoring.
Require documented business ownership, suitable data quality, human oversight, security review, and measurable benefits before analytics or AI solutions move into production.
Coordinate with engineering, operations, and technology teams when operational, training, mission-system, or live and synthetic data may be used, ensuring the work remains within approved classification and authorization boundaries.
Monitor model performance, data drift, access, and business outcomes, and retire solutions that no longer meet operational, security, or financial requirements.

Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership

Build and lead a capable team spanning data governance, architecture, engineering, BI, and analytics; define roles, develop talent, and manage succession for critical skills.
Partner with executives and functional leaders to convert business questions into governed data products, clear measures, and practical decisions.
Create an active network of business data owners and stewards and hold regular reviews of quality, adoption, access, and value realization.
Manage external partners and vendors through clear outcomes, architecture standards, service levels, security requirements, and commercial accountability.
Communicate data risks, progress, tradeoffs, and investment needs to senior leadership in concise business terms.

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, data engineering, analytics, business, engineering, or a related discipline. A graduate degree or relevant professional certification is an asset.
At least 10 years of progressive experience in data management, analytics, BI, enterprise applications, or data architecture, including at least five years leading teams or major cross-functional programs.
Experience in aerospace, defense, aviation, MRO, or another highly regulated and asset-intensive industry is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience improving data quality and reporting in a complex ERP or MRO environment. Direct experience with Ramco is a significant asset; experience with comparable aviation or enterprise platforms is also relevant.
Experience operating across multiple countries, legal entities, or security domains, including Canada and the United States, is preferred.

Technical and Regulatory Knowledge

Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture, dimensional and semantic modelling, master data management, metadata, data quality, lineage, SQL, APIs, and ETL or ELT integration.
Hands-on understanding of modern cloud data platforms and BI technologies. Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Power BI, and Microsoft data services is preferred.
Working knowledge of aviation maintenance and supply-chain data, including serialized components, configuration, maintenance planning, technical records, reliability, and inventory transactions.
Familiarity with aviation regulatory and quality environments such as Transport Canada, FAA, EASA, safety management systems, and AS9100 is an asset.
Working knowledge of information classification, access control, auditability, privacy, data residency, the Canadian Controlled Goods Program, ITAR and EAR, CUI safeguards, CMMC, and NIST SP 800-171, as applicable to the role and programs supported.
Ability to obtain and maintain the security clearances, controlled-goods eligibility, and customer or program authorizations required for the position.

Leadership Competencies

Business judgment that connects data investment to safety, mission readiness, contract delivery, customer commitments, and financial performance.
Ability to influence executives, operational leaders, technical specialists, and front-line users without relying solely on formal authority.
Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain data limitations, security constraints, and architectural decisions to non-technical audiences.
Disciplined program leadership, with practical experience managing priorities, budgets, vendors, risks, and organizational change.
Commitment to Top Aces' values of Service, Integrity, Excellence, and Together.
Professional fluency in English is required. French and additional languages us

jobs.title: Global Head of CSV Governance & Standards
jobs.description:
We are open to remote applicant from the whole EMEA region living in promixity to one of our offices.
The resource will report directly t
o the Global Head of Contract Logistics IT Deployment, with dotted line links into Corporate IT compliance, healthcare vertical and QSHE.

‎

The global head of csv Governance & Standards will define, own, and govern Kuehne+Nagel’s global CSV/CSA policy, framework, standards, and decision model across all business units. This role ensures consistent adoption of risk-based validation practices within the IT governance process, while operational CSV execution, audit readiness, and system compliance remain the responsibility of system owners and IT/QA teams.

How you create impact

Owns the global CSV/CSA policy, framework, standards, and decision‑making model, ensuring alignment with SDLC and regulatory expectations.
Defines when CSV, CSA, or other risk‑based approaches apply and embeds these rules into IT processes.
Provides central governance and expert guidance across all Business Units, Functions, and IT/IS teams working with regulated systems.
Acts as the senior escalation point for governance‑related CSV/CSA issues.
Ensures the governance model evolves with FDA, EMA, GAMP5, CSA, and broader industry trends, leading the transition from CSV to CSA.
Owns global templates, risk models, and guidance documents to ensure consistent regulatory interpretation.Builds global capability through training and awareness on CSV/CSA principles and risk‑based validation.
Collaborates with key stakeholders across Corporate IT, QSHE, Healthcare, CL, and InfoSec to ensure alignment and drive adoption.

What we would like you to bring

Strategic Mindset: Ability to define long-term CSV/CSA governance strategy and roadmap.
Organisational Agility: Experience navigating large matrix organisations and leading cross-business initiatives.
Regulatory Expertise: Deep knowledge of GAMP5, CSV, CSA, GDP, GMP, ISO 9001, and healthcare regulations.
Process & Governance Design: Ability to build frameworks, governance standards, and risk-based decision models.
Risk Management: Strong grasp of risk-based validation principles and methodologies.
Stakeholder Engagement: Exceptional communication and influence across functions and levels.
Training & Development: Ability to raise global capability on CSV/CSA governance.

What's in it for you

By joining the Kuehne+Nagel team, you will have the opportunity to work in a safe and stable environment, with a strong focus on physical and mental well-being. We offer professional growth and development opportunities, including at an international level.

Who We Are

Logistics shapes our everyday lives – from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kühne+Nagel, your work is more than logistics; through your career, you become part of people’s everyday and extraordinary moments around the world.

As a global market leader with a rich heritage, our vision is to move the world forward. What we offer you is a secure, stable environment where your work can make a real difference in people’s lives. Whether it’s delivering life‑saving medicines, enabling sustainable transport, or supporting local communities, your career can mean more than you ever imagined.

MNP is proudly Canadian. Providing business strategies and solutions, we are a leading national accounting, tax and business advisory firm in Canada. Entrepreneurial to our core, our talented team members transcend obstacles into opportunities and are successfully transforming mid-market business practices.

Responsibilities

Identify opportunities to transform existing service offerings, engagement delivery models, internal processes, and business operations through AI, automation, analytics, and emerging technologies

jobs.title: Director, Technology Delivery and Enablement
jobs.description:
This is a hybrid position, with four days per week in the office and one day remote.

Office Location:
1 Presidents Choice Cir, Brampton, ON L6Y 5S5 (near Hwy. 407 and Mississauga Rd)

Lifemark Health Group (LHG) is a market leader in customized healthcare solutions. With over 20 years of service excellence, LHG is one of the largest, most trusted, and most comprehensive providers in Canada. As a national healthcare company, LHG employs over 5,000 highly trained clinicians, medical experts, and team members in almost 400 locations coast-to-coast and continues to grow both organically as well as through acquisitions. With that growth is a vision to be the most innovative healthcare provider in community rehabilitation, workplace health and wellness, and medical assessment services. Lifemark was acquired by Loblaw Companies on May 10, 2022.

Role Overview:

Lifemark Health Group is hiring a Director, Technology Delivery and Enablement to lead our Application Development Team and advance the modernization of our enterprise application landscape. Reporting to the VP, Engineering and Security Services, you will oversee the development, implementation, modernization, and ongoing reliability of critical business applications supporting Lifemark’s national operations.

In this hands-on technology leadership role, you will lead teams of developers, DevOps engineers, and QA specialists to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient solutions while evolving our engineering practices and technology platforms. You will champion modern approaches including cloud-native architecture, DevSecOps, platform engineering, intelligent automation, and AI-assisted software development, while improving application observability, engineering productivity, and delivery effectiveness.

Working closely with business and technology leaders, you will help shape Lifemark’s application modernization and technology strategy, including the responsible adoption of generative AI and emerging technologies, reduction of technical debt, modernization of legacy platforms, and continued evolution of our Azure ecosystem. You will also collaborate across departments, security and infrastructure teams, architecture, data and analytics, and external technology partners to ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.

About You:

You are an experienced technology leader with a strong background in software and application development and a track record of leading high-performing technical teams. You combine hands-on technical depth with strong people leadership, delivery discipline, and the ability to translate business needs into secure, scalable technology solutions.

You are comfortable managing multiple concurrent initiatives, guiding application architecture and development practices, building strong cross-functional and vendor relationships, and continuously improving release management, DevOps, monitoring, quality, and reliability. You communicate clearly, develop talent, and stay current with emerging technologies and industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership and Team Management

Manage the development and maintenance of Lifemark websites and enterprise applications, providing technical leadership, oversight, and execution.
Plan, organize, prioritize, and delegate work assignments; oversee team results for quality, timely delivery, and adherence to policies and procedures.
Attract, mentor, develop, and retain top talent while supporting career development and succession planning.

Architecture, Development and Reliability

Provide guidance on application architecture, UI/UX, database design, and integration with back-end applications.
Maintain high stability, uptime, and reliability of enterprise applications through robust monitoring and QA practices.
Experience leading modern DevSecOps and platform engineering practices, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security, observability, cloud-native architecture, and AI-assisted software development.

Project Execution and Release Management

Lead and support concurrent initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals, schedules, and quality standards.
Plan, coordinate, and execute successful software releases using disciplined release management practices.

Vendor and Cross-Functional Collaboration

Manage relationships with third-party agencies and technology vendors to deliver robust and scalable solutions.
Build strong relationships across departments to align technology solutions with business objectives and improve operational efficiency.

Continuous Improvement and Innovation

Research and evaluate emerging technologies to meet business needs and continuously enhance development practices and tools.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI technologies, including machine learning and cognitive services, for automation solutions where appropriate.

What we’re looking for:

Post-secondary education in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
10+ years of software/application development experience, including 3+ years in leadership roles.
Strong understanding of application lifecycle management, system architecture, and development methodologies.
Proficiency in .NET development, relational databases, and cloud platforms; Azure experience is preferred.
Experience managing parallel projects, with strong time-management and organizational skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Exceptional project and account management abilities, with a demonstrated ability to establish and meet schedules.
Current knowledge of industry trends and development best practices.
Collaborative mindset with proven team leadership experience.
Strong release management experience, including planning, coordinating, and executing software releases.
Demonstrated success attracting, mentoring, and retaining top talent and supporting career development and succession planning.
Proven record of maintaining high stability, uptime, and reliability of enterprise applications through robust monitoring and QA practices.
Expertise implementing DevOps best practices, including automated pipelines, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Experience evaluating and applying generative AI, large language models, AI agents, machine learning, and intelligent automation to improve business processes, engineering productivity, and customer or employee experiences. Familiarity with responsible AI, security, privacy, and governance considerations is an asset.

What Success Looks like:

Enterprise applications and Lifemark websites are delivered and maintained with strong technical leadership, quality, stability, and reliability.
Development, DevOps, and QA teams are effectively organized, supported, and developed to deliver high-quality outcomes on schedule.
Application architecture, development practices, monitoring, QA, and release management continue to mature and support secure, scalable solutions.
Concurrent initiatives are delivered in alignment with business goals, schedules, and quality standards.
Vendor and cross-functional partnerships effectively support business objectives and operational efficiency.
Emerging technologies and improved development practices are evaluated and adopted where they provide clear business value.

Our Perks:

You will be issued a company laptop, headset and a home office monitor, keyboard, and mouse. After your successful probation period, you will:

Eligibility to earn a STIP (Short-Term Incentive Plan)
Have access to a yearly education re-imbursement fund
Receive 30% discount from Shopper Drug Mart purchases
Contribute to an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) with employer matching percentage
Have paid vacation days as well as wellness days
Have a choice to enroll in our Health & Dental Flex Life Benefits (or in lieu contribute to your RRSPs)
Access to employee assistance program
On-site gym, Basketball & Volleyball courts, Ice Rink, Groceries delivered to work via PC Express, Dry-Cleaning services (1 Presidents Choice Circle Office)

Inclusion

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive. Improving inclusion and equity is a collective responsibility. Lifemark promotes equal employment opportunities for all job applicants, including but not limited to those self-identifying as a member of the employment equity groups: Indigenous peoples, Newcomers to Canada, Women, and Visible minorities.

Accommodations are available on request for all candidates taking part in any aspect of the recruitment and selection process. Email us at Talentatlifemark

jobs.title: Directeur régional des technologies de l’information - Région de Montréal/Information Technology Regional Director - Montreal
jobs.description:
MDA Space (TSX : MDA) est un partenaire de mission de confiance de l’industrie spatiale mondiale qui crée l’espace entre ce qui est prouvé et ce qui est possible. À titre de pionnier de la robotique, des systèmes satellitaires et du renseignement géospatial, avec une histoire de 55 ans de premières mondiales et de plus de 450 missions, MDA Space est un chef de file mondial dans les domaines des satellites de communication, de l’observation de la Terre et de l’espace, ainsi que de l’infrastructure et l’exploration spatiale. L’équipe de MDA Space, qui compte plus de 4 000 experts du secteur spatial au Canada, aux États-Unis et au Royaume-Uni, possède les connaissances et le savoir-faire nécessaires pour transformer la vision audacieuse du client en une mission réalisable, grâce à une combinaison unique d’expérience, d’excellence technique et d’émerveillement qui fait partie de notre ADN depuis le premier jour. Pour ceux qui rêvent grand et repoussent les limites sur terre et dans les étoiles afin de changer le monde pour le meilleur, nous vous y emmènerons.

Le Rôle

MDA Space connaît une croissance fulgurante, et nous sommes à la recherche d’un dirigeant technologique visionnaire pour piloter l’expérience informatique de plus de 2 000 collaborateurs
répartis entre Montréal, Kirkland, Sainte-Anne-de-Bellevue et d’autres emplacements stratégiques. Vous serez responsable de l’expérience utilisateur de bout en bout, mènerez des projets d’amélioration des services, gérerez les contrats avec les fournisseurs et veillerez au respect des normes ITIL/ITSM, de cybersécurité et de plan de continuité des activités (PCA). Si vous vous épanouissez dans des environnements dynamiques et à fort impact, et que vous aimez transformer des environnements techniques complexes en services fluides et centrés sur l’utilisateur, ce poste vous permettra de propulser votre carrière vers de nouveaux horizons.

Le directeur régional des technologies de l’information (TI), région de Montréal, supervisera la prestation des services informatiques locaux pour l’emplacement de Montréal et les emplacements environnants, en veillant à offrir une expérience employé de qualité, à garantir la fiabilité des opérations et à respecter les normes de MDA Space. À ce titre, il travaillera en collaboration avec les dirigeants locaux, les équipes de TI régionales, les fournisseurs et les intervenants de l’entreprise afin d’améliorer la qualité des services, de soutenir la croissance, de gérer les risques et de s’assurer que les services de TI répondent aux besoins actuels et futurs de l’entreprise.

Principales Responsabilités

Favoriser une excellente expérience des collaborateurs de TI sur les sites relevant de sa responsabilité / entrant dans son champ d’action
Favoriser l’implication des services de TI au sein du site – en veillant à ce que les collaborateurs des TI travaillent comme une seule et même équipe
Diriger les services de TI locaux afin d’offrir une expérience employé homogène et de grande qualité à Montréal et aux emplacements environnants.
Collaborer avec les dirigeants du site et les équipes des TI régionales afin de soutenir la croissance, de résoudre les problèmes et d’améliorer le rendement des services.
Communiquer de manière claire et concrète sur les services des TI, les normes, le rendement et la sensibilisation à la cybersécurité au sein du site.
Surveiller les performances des services locaux, les risques et les plans d’amélioration à l’aide de rapports et de tableaux de bord standardisés.
Veiller à ce que l’infrastructure, les outils et les services locaux respectent les normes de MDA Space et garantissent la continuité des activités.
Servir de point de contact local pour les incidents informatiques, les projets et les problèmes liés aux services, en assurant la coordination avec les équipes concernées pour trouver des solutions.
Soutenir les équipes de production et d’exploitation en garantissant que les services de TI sont fiables, cohérents et alignés sur les priorités de l’entreprise.
Superviser les ressources de TI locales, les services des fournisseurs, les contrats et la mise en œuvre des projets liés aux modifications ou aux extensions des sites.
Veiller au respect des exigences en matière de TI, de sécurité, de gestion des actifs, de la norme SOX et d’assurance qualité.

Direction Et Relations

Établir d’excellentes relations avec les dirigeants locaux, les partenaires commerciaux, les équipes de TI et les fournisseurs afin de garantir que les services répondent aux besoins de l’entreprise.
Diriger, encadrer et soutenir l’équipe des TI locale tout en encourageant la collaboration, la responsabilisation et l’amélioration continue.
Représenter le service des TI au niveau local et aider les employés à comprendre l’assistance, les services et les interlocuteurs à leur disposition.

Priorités

Expérience des employés: Donner l’exemple et donner le ton au sein de la direction des TI en mettant l’accent sur la promotion d’une expérience des employés exceptionnelle à travers l’ensemble des services des TI; diriger et faire évoluer l’infrastructure, les outils et les services de TI du site afin de soutenir le personnel; garantir une prestation de services de grande qualité et une amélioration continue, en accord avec les stratégies mondiales de MDA Space.
Direction d’équipe: constituer, diriger et développer une équipe locale de professionnels des TI qualifiés; être responsable du recrutement et de l’intégration des nouveaux membres de l’équipe, ainsi que de la mise en place de méthodes de travail efficaces.
Gestion technologique: maintenir une compréhension approfondie des technologies et des services de MDA Space; documenter et maintenir l’environnement technique du site afin de garantir que les performances actuelles et futures répondent aux besoins de l’entreprise.
Implication des collaborateurs: Représenter l’équipe technique des TI du site au sein d’une communauté de partenaires et de collaborateurs professionnels; veiller à la cohérence des prestations, conformément aux feuilles de route et aux normes mondiales.
Opérations et conformité: Gérer les contrats et les services des fournisseurs locaux; veiller au respect des normes informatiques, de la sécurité et des exigences de conformité.
Défense des intérêts des utilisateurs finaux: adopter une approche proactive et concrète en matière d’assistance et d’expérience utilisateur; identifier les possibilités d’exploiter les capacités existantes pour obtenir de meilleurs résultats.
Calendrier et lieu: Dans un premier temps, le titulaire du poste aura pour mission de garantir une excellente expérience employé en pilotant divers projets de manière transversale.

Compétences Et Expérience Requises

Passion pour la prestation d’un service d’excellence, en cherchant constamment à améliorer l’expérience utilisateur et à optimiser la performance.
Expérience dans un poste de direction à titre de responsable de services, avec une expérience avérée dans la prise en charge, la gestion et la responsabilité d’un service, d’une plateforme ou d’outils informatiques
Maîtrise parfaite de l’anglais et du français, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.
Expérience avérée dans le secteur de l’industrie ou des services
Expérience avérée dans la prestation et l’exploitation de services
Une compréhension technique approfondie couvrant un large éventail de technologies et de domaines.
Bonnes compétences en communication et en engagement, et expérience avérée dans la gestion des relations professionnelles
Excellentes compétences en matière de collaboration pour gérer les attentes locales et trouver des solutions
Excellentes compétences en matière d’influence, de réseautage et de travail d’équipe
Expérience approfondie dans un environnement normatif, réglementé et conforme
Excellente connaissance pratique de l’ITIL, des outils ITSM ou équivalents
Expérience avérée dans la gestion des fournisseurs locaux, des contrats, des renouvellements et des appels d’offres
Dirigeant et coéquipier : donne l’exemple à l’équipe ou encadre les autres; collaboration efficace avec ses pairs dans toute la région.
Expérience en gestion et en développement d’équipes, dans un environnement de travail ouvert, honnête, responsable et collaboratif.

Compétences Et Expérience Souhaitées

PMP
Six Sigma Ceinture noire
Certification ITIL

jobs.description:
Founded in 2000 by three former Royal Canadian Air Force (RCAF) CF-18 fighter pilots who identified an opportunity to improve military readiness training, Top Aces has since established itself as the world leader in contracted adversary air (ADAIR) services and joint terminal attack controller (JTAC) training.

We pride ourselves on our unblemished safety record, having flown an industry leading 130,000+ hours of operational training without accident in support of customers worldwide, including Canada, the U.S., Germany, and multiple other NATO allies and international partner nations.

Our vision is to be the most trusted provider of innovative defense training solutions, continuously elevating standards in an industry where "Experience Matters." This commitment to innovation and technology ensures we remain adaptable, training allied militaries to succeed against evolving threats.

Top Aces’ dynamic team contributes to delivering on our purpose of training the next generation of combat leaders by living our values of Service, Integrity, Excellence, and Together every day!

Join our team!

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Director FP&A and Capital Investment is a key member of the company’s finance team and is responsible for supporting all financial planning and analysis activities across the International Division of Top Aces Inc. The director will be responsible for the division’s annual budget process, financial forecasting, financial strategic planning and business performance analysis activities. Additionally, the director will be responsible for supporting the effort to enhance the company’s continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving profitability and efficiency. The director will provide project financial support, return on investment (ROI) analysis along with KPI development, measurement and analysis. The successful candidate will have demonstrable leadership competencies, strong attention to detail, and will work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment. The candidate will demonstrate a successful track record of working collaboratively in a dynamic environment and a matrix organizational structure.

Own the division’s annual budgeting and financial planning process (quarterly forecasts and strategic plan 5-year forecast) and review all associated financial plans and budgets.
Develop, lead, and manage core FP&A activities.
Lead the development of P&L, balance sheet and cash flow forecasts and partner with internal stakeholders to optimize working capital (prepayments, inventory) and cash flow generation.
Lead the development of scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis and risks & opportunities.

Oversee capex financial management and capex forecasting improvement initiatives.
Lead inventory financial management and work with key stakeholders to optimize the level of inventory.
Oversee the preparation of the International Division monthly management accounts, FP&A reports and dashboards, including presentations to SLT and the company’s Board of Directors.
Support the division’s Senior Leadership Team (SLT) to evaluate and review new business and investment opportunities, including new business pricing, client Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), Return on Investment (ROI), payback period and return on capital (RONA) analyses.
Support the executive team decision-making by providing insightful data and analysis with the objective of improving Top Aces’ profitability and efficiency.
Build and develop the skill sets of finance professionals under her/his direction.

Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree required with concentration in finance and/or accounting or comparable business field preferred.
CPA and/or MBA preferred
10-15 years of experience in relevant accounting, or financial leadership roles.
Significant expertise with data analysis and reporting.
Ability to handle multiple assignments on a timely basis with a high degree of accuracy.
High level of motivation and aptitude for problem solving, with a strong attention to detail.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills as well as strategic thinking to effectively interface with external stakeholders and the division’s Senior Leadership Team.
Ability to translate financial data into strategic insights.
Able to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines, possessing a high sense of urgency.
Ability to perform all work in support of our Corporate Values of Excellence, Service, Integrity … Together.

Working Conditions:

May be required to travel from time to time
May be required to work overtime or longer hours when Top Aces Requires

Supervisory, Training and Advisory Responsibilities:

May be required to provide regular guidance, advice and training, as requested by the supervisor, to other employees supporting the function.

Occupational Health and Safety:

Employees are responsible for:

Working in compliance with Occupational Health and Safety acts and regulations
Following safe work practices and procedures and using safeguards and personal protective equipment
Reporting hazards (such as unsafe situations and activities) to their supervisor immediately.

Security Clearance Requirements/ CGP / ITAR:

Position requires Level II clearance with the Canadian Government and the ability to gain access to the Canadian Controlled Goods Program

By joining Top Aces, you will find:

A work environment in which service, integrity, excellence and teamwork are highly valued;
Opportunities for development and growth;
Multidisciplinary and multicultural collaboration at a local and global level;
A flexible schedule;
Attractive benefit plan.

Come share your passion with us! Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered, and challenged to be your best self.

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.

Performance Management & Analysis

Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.

Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.

Financial and commercial acumen

Problem solving

Results orientation and a bias for action

About Toronto Metropolitan

For more than 75 years, Toronto Metropolitan University (formerly known as Ryerson University) has been shaping the next generation of leaders through its uniquely innovative, entrepreneurial and career-focused approach to higher education. Driven by bold leadership, cutting-edge research and a deep commitment to academic excellence, TMU collaborates with students, faculties, staff and partners to push boundaries, reimagine solutions and create meaningful change in an increasingly interconnected world.

For a more in-depth understanding of our vision, core values and ongoing work, please see our academic plan

TMU welcomes those who have demonstrated a commitment to upholding the values of equity, diversity, and inclusion and will assist us in realizing the benefits of embedding these values into the work at every level and in every unit of the university. In addition, to correct the conditions of disadvantage in employment in Canada and to bring lived experiences to the work, we encourage applications from members of equity deserving groups that have been historically disadvantaged and marginalized, including First Nations, Métis and Inuit Peoples in Canada, First Nations Peoples in the United States, racialized people, Black people, persons with disabilities, women, and 2SLGBTQ+ people. Preference will be given to candidates with lived experiences as people from equity deserving groups, as well as experience working with these communities with which the University works every day. Please note that all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply and we welcome newcomers and immigrants to Canada.

In April 2022, the university announced its new name of Toronto Metropolitan University. Learn more about our next chapter.

About The Faculty Of Community Services

The nine Schools within the Faculty of Community Services (FCS) offer professional programs that prepare individuals for addressing the health and social care needs of multiple population groups. Our programs are designed to encourage students to be creative and critical thinkers and effective problem solvers, who can transcend disciplinary boundaries to find lasting solutions to social issues. We prepare our students to navigate an increasingly globalized workplace, characterized by the integration of diverse peoples, cultures, technologies, economies and political processes. We work with multiple accreditation bodies to deliver the highest quality of learning and we promote innovation in practice and research. To learn more about the Faculty of Community Services, visit https://www.torontomu.ca/fcs/ or through our social channels: @FCSTorontoMet on Twitter and FCSTorontoMet on Instagram.

We especially welcome applications from individuals who self-identify as women, Black, Indigenous, racialized persons, persons with disabilities, or members of 2SLGBTQ+ communities, who will be integral towards serving our highly diverse student, faculty, and staff complement. If you identify with any of these equity-deserving groups, we encourage you to self-identify in your cover letter. We are committed to building a culture that recognizes, celebrates, and reflects diversity, and we welcome you to join us.

The Opportunity

We are currently seeking a Director, Strategic Planning, Operations and Administration
to join our team. This role will provide effective strategic leadership of financial planning and management, administration and operations management for the FCS Dean’s Office and Schools within the Faculty. They will collaborate with the Dean and academic leadership of the Faculty during the strategic planning process, supporting and contributing to the development of short- and long-term strategies to execute the vision of the Dean, and to support the University’s strategic goals and priorities, by providing financial, operational and administrative perspectives for academic and non-academic matters.

The successful candidate will lead the effective management and administration of the Faculty’s financial and human resources affairs in an efficient, innovative and professional manner, in accordance with university policies, procedures, applicable collective agreements and Faculty goals and objectives as determined by the Dean. Additionally, they will represent the Dean and the Faculty in long-term financial/human resources/operational planning activities at the University level.

Key Responsibilities

Operational and Academic Strategic Planning: Actively collaborates with the academic leadership and supports the strategic planning process. Participates with the Dean and academic leadership in planning activities, by providing financial and administrative perspectives in operationalizing the Dean’s Academic Plan for the academic and non-academic matters.
Financial Management and Reporting: Provides strategic leadership, direction and oversight to the faculty financial operations team, ensuring robust financial management, governance and consistency across the FCS Dean’s Office and the Faculty as a whole.
Administrative Operations: In consultation with the Dean, Associate Deans and Directors, oversees the operation of non-academic services in the Faculty to ensure resources are available and fairly distributed to appropriately support academic objectives.
Collective Agreement Management: Provides expert advice, assistance and guidance to Dean, Associate Deans, Directors, faculty and managers within the Faculty, relative to the proper interpretation and administration of the various subsisting collective agreements.
Physical Resources and Infrastructure Management: In consultation with the Dean and Directors, reviews objectives and makes recommendations for efficient utilization of space within the control of the Faculty. Provides financial counsel and risk management advice for infrastructure planning and decision making purposes.
HR Management: Serves as a primary administrative point of contact for the Dean and Faculty leadership on HR-related processes, providing guidance on applicable procedures, facilitating the resolution of routine HR matters, and engaging central HR for advice and support on more complex issues.

Leadership Competencies

Leaders at TMU are required to demonstrate the following Leadership Competencies:

Acts with Integrity: Demonstrates behaviors aligned with high ethical standards and personal integrity and acts in accordance with TMU values.
Builds Relationships of Trust & Collaboration: Actively builds a culture of trust and fosters meaningful relationships.
Leads Inclusively: Creates an inclusive environment where everyone is respected, recognized, empowered to achieve their potential, and valued for their differences.
Demonstrates Organizational Acumen: Understands and respectfully navigates complex internal and external environments using sound judgment, diplomacy, and tact.
Drives Vision & Results: Creates and implements a vision grounded in sound decision-making to achieve desired outcomes.

Qualifications

To help us learn more about you, please provide a cover letter and resume describing how you meet the following required qualifications:

Completion of a university degree program in business or public administration, strategic and financial planning and administration, or in a relevant field.
Minimum of seven (7) years of progressively increasing directly related management experience, in financial and resources management, including strategic and financial planning, administration and coordination, and operational oversight preferably in an academic environment.
Demonstrated experience implementing approaches that advance equity, diversity and inclusion; and experience working within the context of diversity.
Five (5) years of demonstrated experience supervising staff in a unionized environment required.
Strong project management and time management skills to manage competing high-level priorities and maintain operational continuity under tight deadlines.
Excellent oral and written communication skills to pitch strategic plans, financial forecasts, and proposals to university leadership, and to produce or review high-level reporting.
Advanced interpersonal communication skills and high emotional intelligence to foster inclusive workplace relationships
Strong financial skills, including knowledge of multi-year budgeting.
Knowledge of accounting methods, university fund accounting, governance, and audit compliance best practices.
Financial risk assessment and data-informed risk modeling skills.
Advanced analytical reasoning skills to evaluate funding models, enrolment impacts, and resource allocation requirements.
The ability to effectively handle complex, concurrent academic and administrative initiatives.
